china-1922:p0224_2.rationale: Table of legal units of length, area, capacity and weight with metric and other equivalents under the Weights and Measures Law.

china-1922:p0225_1.rationale: Conversion table of Chinese weight units (li, fen, ch'ien, liang, chin, tan).

china-1922:p0225_2.rationale: Weight equivalents fixed for foreign trade (liang, catty, picul) with grammes and pounds; a measurement standard used in trade.

china-1922:p0225_3.rationale: Chinese length unit conversions (fen, ts'un, ch'ih, chang, li), with a footnote on the customs ch'ih.

china-1922:p0225_4.rationale: Comparison of the ch'ih length standard in inches across trades and institutions.

china-1922:p0225_5.rationale: Chinese area unit conversion series (ssu, hao, li, fen, mow, ch'ing, pu).

china-1922:p0226_1.rationale: Chinese capacity unit conversions (ko, sheng, tow, shih).

china-1922:p0227_1.rationale: Chronological list of the years Western nations began direct trade with China; the years are dates in a historical sequence rather than statistical quantities, so the table is textual. No existing tag fits a chronology limited to trade history, and historical-chronologies is meant for general multi-subject chronologies.
review_questions: Should a tag be proposed for the history of foreign trade contact or trade chronologies?

china-1922:p0235_1.rationale: Percentage advance in the value of exports across periods from 1900 to 1919.

china-1922:p0237_1.rationale: Percentage shares of exports by article (tea, silk, sugar, sundries) in 1879, from a pie chart. Only the 1879 part is transcribed, although the title lists 1899 and 1919 as well.
review_questions: The title lists 1879, 1899 and 1919 but only 1879 is transcribed; is the record incomplete?
